claims.claim: Very clean ps4 slim special edition
claims.evidence: Photo shows gold slim-style PS4 but no model/serial plate confirming 'special edition' variant; cosmetic cleanliness not assessed from all angles.

claims.claim: with follow come controller and other accessories
claims.evidence: No controller, cables, or accessories visible in the single photo.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: Opening/repair history cannot be seen from an external photo; would require internal or screw-seal inspection.
Requires a power-on/running test, not shown.
Rear ports not visible in the photo.
No controllers/pads visible in the photo.

risks.risk: Console may not actually be a 'special edition' variant, just a gold-painted standard slim
risks.proof: Clear photo of rear/bottom serial sticker and model number (CUH-2xxx series)
risks.if_unproven: priced as standard PS4 slim, not special edition

risks.risk: Accessories (controller, cables, power adapter) may not be included or may be mismatched/non-OEM
risks.proof: Photo showing controller(s), power cable, HDMI cable, and box contents laid out together

risks.risk: Hidden cosmetic damage or wear on underside/back/ports not visible in current photo
risks.proof: Additional photos of all sides including underside and rear port area
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming moderate cosmetic wear (worst case for 'clean' claim)

risks.risk: Internal fault, overheating, or non-working ports despite seller's claim
risks.proof: Short video of console powering on, booting to home screen, and a controller/cable connected and functioning
Photo of system settings storage screen or rear sticker showing GB capacity

risks.risk: Claimed UK receipt may not exist or may not match this unit
risks.proof: Clear photo of the receipt showing matching serial number if possible
risks.if_unproven: priced as no proof of original purchase/import history

proof_requests: Photo of rear panel with serial number/model sticker (CUH-2xxx)
Photos of all included accessories laid out (controller, cables, adapter)
Photos of top, bottom, and rear of console showing any wear/damage
Short video of console powering on and booting to home screen
Photo of storage capacity in system settings
Clear photo of the UK receipt
response.reason: Witness confirms a PS4 slim-style console, so it can be priced, but all seller claims beyond basic identity are unverified or unverifiable remotely and must be priced at worst case (standard variant, console-only, untested) until the listed proofs are provided.
